_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in your values. Alternatively use environment variables — see docker-compose.yml.

tariffs._comment: Standard day/night tariff (no boost or peak). Add a new entry whenever rates change; historical entries are kept to cost older data correctly.

Example: Electric Ireland Home Dual + Night Boost (three-band tariff). import_night_boost_rate and night_boost_hours are optional — omit them for a plain day/night tariff. A future peak tariff would add import_peak_rate and peak_hours in the same way.

night_boost_hours._comment: Night Boost window — must fall inside night_hours below.

standing_charges._comment: Daily network standing charge ex VAT. Add entries as rates change.

pso_levy._comment: Government PSO levy as monthly figure ex VAT. Changes each October.

night_hours._comment: Night rate window in Irish clock time. DST is handled automatically. The boost window (if any) must fall within this range.
